rule: A package is done when its acceptance criteria are met, not when the work reads well. Labels are capabilities, never model names.

packages.brief: Author the Humanesque core page from the ontology federation, and state for each of O0 to O25 whether a component realises it.
acceptance: each says realised / partly / not established

packages.brief: For each cultural derivation, state what it derives and what it does NOT: the anti-conflation rules made concrete per projection.
acceptance: each names at least three things it is not

packages.brief: Fill the domain registry from the collaborator domain map: 390 declared, 66 enumerated. Each entry needs its own enablement list, never a shared one.
acceptance: no two domains share an enablement list

packages.brief: Generate a lab kit per enumerated domain and price one bill of materials end to end, so 'low cost' becomes a measurement.
acceptance: at least one BoM with every line sourced

packages.brief: Stand up one Holy Grail lab on real hardware and record the loop closing: research, formalisation, simulation, prototype, experiment, instrumentation, observation, evidence, verification, revision.
acceptance: an evidence crate with an instrument named
a rung promoted with its artifact

packages.brief: Declare the non-file rights: trademarks, filings, registered marks, with jurisdiction and number. A filing date is declared by the author, never inferred.
acceptance: registry items of type trademark and patent carry a jurisdiction

packages.brief: Resolve every 'precedence not established' by verifying its OTS proof or reading its deposit date from the registrar.
acceptance: each resolved date names its source

packages.brief: Give each projection its own visual identity within one design system, without forking the page generator.
Extend the walk beyond the two orgs: discover every org the token can see and record which were walked and which were not.
Define the promotion process from test to production: what evidence, whose gate, and what is recorded when it passes.
